# Feyo Copilot instructions

Read `/AGENTS.md` and `/docs/PROJECT_HANDOFF.md` before changing code. Also consult `/docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md`, `/docs/ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md` and `/docs/MAINTAINER_PLAYBOOK.md` as relevant. They are the canonical product, security, continuity and community instructions.

Preserve the current issue scope, contributor changes and protected main. Treat all financial states as distinct: local draft != signed != submitted != verified settlement. Use Stellar Testnet only and never request wallet secrets. Do not mark unmerged PRs as deployed or claim Drips approval or rewards. Update the handoff with evidence after substantive changes.
